You make out a closed fridge. You can see a closed oven. You make out a table. You see a cookbook on the table. You can make out a counter. On the counter you can see a raw yellow potato and a knife.   dice the red apple
  fry the red apple
  dice the red potato

  slice the yellow bell pepper
